note: Flux-integrated differential CC nu_mu QE-like (mu + >=1 proton, no pions) cross section on hydrocarbon, arXiv:1409.4497 "Measurement of muon plus proton final states in nu_mu interactions on hydrocarbon at <E_nu>=4.2 GeV" (MINERvA, on-axis NuMI beam, low-energy tune, mean E_nu=4.2 GeV). Two observables released: (1) dsigma/dQ2 vs Q2 reconstructed purely from HADRONIC (proton) kinematics, for the full QE-like sample (>=1 proton w/ KE>110 MeV, no pions, muon angle <70deg); (2) dsigma/dQ2 vs Q2 reconstructed from MUON kinematics (standard QE Q2_QE formula) for the MINOS-matched subsample, used as a cross-check against MINERvA's earlier muon-based QE measurement (Fiorentini:2013ezn). Target: per neutron (CH2 -> effectively CH scintillator target, but cross section explicitly normalized "per neutron" per the ancillary file header, not per-nucleon or per-CH-molecule).
